name: Saurer Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd
summary: Saurer Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of intelligent textile equipment and core components for fiber and yarn processing in Europe, Africa, India, America, Turkey, China, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers blowroom and carding pre-spinning machines; roving, automation, ring, compact, rotor, and air spinning machines; and carpet yarn, glass filament yarn, industrial yarn, staple fibre yarn, and tire cord yard twisting and cabling machines.
